title: Page 3
lines: 小丫头直都是个好的，只是摊上偏心的爹娘，再加上自个儿不争，旁人想帮忙也无力，只怕这辈子是毁了。
他虽心有不舍，但也没有试图改变什么，自个儿的路终要自己走出来。
赵小丫头也不回的跑了段，还没跑出竹林就阵头晕，最后不得不喘着气停下来，在天旋地转之中瘫坐在地。
这副身子现下真得太弱，赵小丫抬头看着透过竹林的光线无力的心想。
阵微风吹来，竹叶摆荡，吹散了夏末的暑意。
上辈子很长段时间，她听不到任何声音，如今风声、树叶摆动声听来是如此美妙。
久久，她露出了抹笑。
日子很苦，再苦也得笑。如今她又能听到声音，她相信切都会变得更好。
烙饼的香气勾引着她，她受不了诱惑，拿出来用力咬了口。
老爷爷的日子过得好，家中不缺油和粮食，所以她手中的烙饼分量足，油用得也多，但是……咸得几乎难以入口。
赵小丫对顾乔成的厨艺早就没有期望，顾乔成虽常塞吃的给她，但是那味道真的不提也罢。
她没带水，可实在是饿得紧了，还是把烙饼全数吃进肚子里。
有了点力气她才轻轻吐了口气，撑着身子站起来，缓缓地往村子的方向走去，手抚着兽牙手串，步步走得坚定。
眼底的软弱褪去，上辈子没躲过悲剧，这辈子重来，如果再被算计她就真的是无药可救，活该辈子活在水深火热之中。
上辈子因为苦，她的笑很多。这辈子她依然要笑，但是要快乐的笑。
有些人的心是石头，费尽心思也焐不熟，既然如此，她又何苦为难自己去迎合。
第二章 设计毁名声(1)
接下来几日，赵家平和得不似寻常，赵小丫却彷佛未觉。
上辈子她被打，在床上硬是装死的躺了几日，天真以为家中平和是因为自己打动了娘亲，娘亲决定不把她嫁给李虎，却不知这是暴风雨前的宁静。
今天早看到刘彩凤打扮妥当的出门，赵小丫心中了然，却依然无事似的，该干的活儿半点没有少。
直到天色不早，见刘彩凤还未归家，赵小丫去敲了敲赵雪的房门。
村子里的人都知道赵家两个闺女的待遇是云泥之别，赵雪住的是大堂旁冬暖夏凉的大房间，而赵小丫却住在紧临着灶房的小房间，大小竟比堆放柴火的小屋还小上些。
赵小丫低垂着头，摆出以往软弱的模样站在房门口，平时没得首肯，她不能踏进赵雪的“闺房”。
赵雪听到敲门声，嘴不禁撇，眼底闪过抹算计，慢条斯理的放下手中的绣线，理了理衣裙，这才将门
在夕阳的余晖照耀下，赵雪漂亮得就像天仙似的。
看着她头上金钗闪着光亮，赵小丫有片刻的失神。
赵雪看她看傻了眼，眼中闪着得意，“小丫，有事？”
赵小丫眨了下眼回过神，她早摸清赵雪笑面虎的本性，若说刘彩凤是个恶毒的真小人，赵雪就是个虚伪的伪君子。
赵小丫露出抹怯怯的浅笑，“娘出去了，可是时辰已经不早，我得做饭，若再迟些，爹回来得饿肚子了。”
赵雪状似苦恼的皱了下眉，“瞧我，只顾着理绣线，竟没注意时辰，你等会儿。”
知道赵小丫不敢进门，她没将门给关上，转身走向床边，
家里的粮食大多锁在灶房的柜子里和地窖，平时钥匙放在刘彩凤手上，今天她出门时特地交给赵雪。
赵小丫低头跟在赵雪身后走进灶房，看着她开了柜子从里头拿出粮食、油、盐等调料。
明明是家人，但她们防着赵小丫就跟防贼似的，连粮食都不让赵小丫有机会碰到。
赵小丫心想自己以前当真是个傻的，竟理所当然的受了这些不公平的对待多年。
“今日娘不在，小丫就休息休息。”赵雪转身，娇笑着侧头看着赵小丫，脸和善的说：“平时姊姊也没帮你做些什么，不如今天就由姊姊掌厨，不过你可别嫌弃我的手艺，我只会简单的下个面。”
若是以前，赵小丫肯定感动莫名，如今她却是心中阵发寒，木木的回道：“不成的，娘亲说姊姊是天生富贵命，不能让你干粗活，不然手该粗了。”
自小刘彩凤便娇养赵雪，赵小丫懂事起就被教导要护着姊姊，给姊姊当奴才，不能让姊姊干活，因为以后家里的好日子都得靠姊姊。
“你别紧张，娘不在，你就松快日。”赵雪安抚的拍了拍她的手，“去歇会儿，别在这里看着。我本就厨艺不精，有你在旁盯着只怕会更手忙脚乱。”
赵小丫这次没坚持，乖乖的点了点头，“姊姊可别累着，有事儿就叫我声。”
“知道了。”赵雪轻推了她把，“快出去吧。”
赵小丫走出灶房，但她没有往大堂而去，而是绕到屋外，躲到灶房窗下小心的探头。
赵雪没有注意到她，只专注的煮水，等水煮开，便将面条放进锅。
起锅后，赵雪将面条分装在三个海碗里，防备似的朝门口看了眼，见没有人这才从衣襟内拿出药包撒在其中两碗里。
最后盯着想了会儿，重新起油锅煎了两颗蛋各自放在加药的碗里。
赵小丫看着心直往下沉，原来切真如她上辈子所猜想，她不懂，为什么明明是家人却要陷害她？
她有些失神的坐在地上。
“小丫！”
听到赵雪的声音，赵小丫吸了口气，强打起精神，走到后院随手摘了几根黄瓜回来。
“你去哪了？”赵雪看到她问。
“我见黄瓜再不摘就要老了，所以摘了几根，明天给爹做拍黄瓜，爹爱吃。”
赵雪笑了笑，嘴上言不由衷的夸赞，“还是小丫懂事。”
赵小丫将黄瓜放在旁，目光盯着灶上放了蛋的那两碗面，“看起来真好吃。”
赵雪注意到她的目光，心中冷笑，面上却不显，“这两碗是特地为你和爹做的，趁着娘不在，我拿了两颗鸡蛋给你和爹补身子，你可别跟娘说。”
看着她的笑，赵小丫的心阵阵发寒，就算重活世，她还是想不透赵雪年纪轻轻，为何心思能如此恶毒。
上辈子她看到这碗加了蛋的面时心中有多感动，如今心中就有多厌恶。
她敛下眼，“还是姊姊对我最好。”
“傻丫头，你可是我唯的妹妹。”赵雪拉着她的手，“我不对你好，谁对你好。”
赵小丫笑了笑，不动声色的抽回手，拿出赵老爹做的木托盘将三碗面放在托盘上。
赵雪心想如今出不了岔子，也没和赵小丫抢着干活。
赵小丫看了眼炉灶，“等会儿趁着灶里还有火，我先烧些水让姊姊晚上能擦洗，睡得好些。”
赵雪觉得自己身油烟味，确实想要洗洗，“小丫真懂事，对姊姊真好。”
“我向来真心待姊姊。”原本要走开的赵小丫突然停下脚步，专注的看着赵雪的双眼，“我们是家人。”
赵小丫瘦小，脸不过巴掌大，双眼更显得黑白分明，赵雪看着她圆圆的大眼睛，莫名的心虚升起，但终究只是闪而过。
她自幼被教导自己将来要前往繁华京城，可不是辈子待在大山村里，如今时间到了，出卖她自懂事便看不上眼的赵小丫，就算难受也只是瞬间而已。
“你端着面小心点。”她用手当扇搧了搧，“我先去外头了。”
“好。”赵小丫的回应轻如叹息。
content_en:
The little girl has always been a good person, but she has parents who are partial to her, and since she is not willing to fight for it, others are unable to help her, and she is afraid that her life will be ruined.
Although he felt reluctant to give up, he didn't try to change anything. He had to walk his own path.
Zhao Xiaoya ran for a while without looking back. She felt dizzy before she even got out of the bamboo forest. Finally, she had to stop gasping for breath and collapsed on the ground while the sky was spinning.
This body is really too weak now, Zhao Xiaoya thought feebly as she looked up at the light filtering through the bamboo forest.
A gentle breeze blows, and the bamboo leaves sway, blowing away the heat of late summer.
For a long time in her previous life, she couldn't hear any sounds, but now the sound of wind and leaves moving sounded so wonderful.
For a long time, she smiled.
Life is hard, but no matter how hard it is, you still have to laugh. Now that she can hear voices again, she believes everything will be better.
The aroma of pancakes seduced her, and she couldn't resist the temptation, so she took it out and took a bite.
The old man's life was good, and there was no shortage of oil and food at home, so the pancakes in her hands were generous and used a lot of oil, but... they were so salty that it was almost hard to eat them.
Zhao Xiaoya had no expectations for Gu Qiaocheng's cooking skills. Although Gu Qiaocheng often gave her food, he really didn't mention the taste.
She didn't bring any water, but she was so hungry that she still ate all the pancakes.
When she had some strength, she exhaled softly, stood up and walked slowly towards the village, stroking the animal tooth bracelet with her hand, walking firmly every step of the way.
The weakness in her eyes faded away. She had not escaped tragedy in her previous life. If she were to be plotted again in this life, she would be hopeless and deserve to live in dire straits for the rest of her life.
In her previous life, she laughed a lot because of her suffering. She still wants to laugh in this life, but she wants to laugh happily.
Some people's hearts are like stone, and they can't be familiar with them despite all their efforts. In this case, why should she bother to cater to them herself?
Chapter 2 Design to ruin reputation (1)
In the next few days, the Zhao family was unusually peaceful, but Zhao Xiaoya seemed not to notice.
In her previous life, she was beaten and had to lie on the bed pretending to be dead for several days. She naively thought that the peace at home was because she had impressed her mother, who decided not to marry her to Li Hu, but she didn't know that this was the calm before the storm.
This morning, Zhao Xiaoya saw Liu Caifeng dressed up and went out, but she still seemed to have nothing to do, and there was no shortage of work to do.
Until it was getting late and Liu Caifeng had not returned home, Zhao Xiaoya went and knocked on Zhao Xue's door.
Everyone in the village knew that the two daughters of the Zhao family were treated very differently. Zhao Xue lived in a large room next to the lobby that was warm in winter and cool in summer, while Zhao Xiaoya lived in a small room next to the kitchen, which was actually smaller than a hut where firewood was piled.
Zhao Xiaoya lowered her head and stood at the door of the room with her usual weak look. Normally, she could not step into Zhao Xue's "boudoir" without permission.
When Zhao Xue heard the knock on the door, she couldn't help but curl her lips. A calculating look flashed in her eyes. She slowly put down the embroidery thread in her hand, straightened her clothes, and then opened the door.
Under the afterglow of the setting sun, Zhao Xue was as beautiful as a fairy.
Seeing the golden hairpin shining brightly on her head, Zhao Xiaoya was lost for a moment.
Zhao Xue looked at her and was dumbfounded, her eyes flashing with pride, "Xiaoya, what's the matter?"
Zhao Xiaoya blinked and came back to her senses. She had already figured out the nature of Zhao Xue's smiling tiger. If Liu Caifeng was a vicious villain, Zhao Xue was a hypocritical hypocrite.
Zhao Xiaoya showed a timid smile and said, "Mom is out, but it's already late. I have to cook. If it's any later, dad will be hungry when he comes back."
Zhao Xue frowned in distress, "Look at me, I was just arranging the embroidery thread and didn't pay attention to the time. Please wait a moment."
Knowing that Zhao Xiaoya didn't dare to enter, she didn't close the door, turned around and walked towards the bed.
Most of the food at home is locked in cabinets in the kitchen and in the cellar. The key is usually left in Liu Caifeng's hand, but today she specially handed it to Zhao Xue when she went out.
Zhao Xiaoya lowered her head and followed Zhao Xue into the kitchen, watching her open the cabinet and take out grain, oil, salt and other seasonings.
They were obviously family members, but they guarded Zhao Xiaoya like a thief, not even letting Zhao Xiaoya have a chance to touch the food.
Zhao Xiaoya thought to herself that she was really stupid before, but she had been treated unfairly for many years as a matter of course.
"Mom is not here today, Xiaoya will rest." Zhao Xue turned around, looked at Zhao Xiaoya with a sweet smile, and said kindly: "My sister usually doesn't do anything for you, so why not let her cook today, but don't dislike my skills, I will only make simple noodles."
In the past, Zhao Xiaoya would have been inexplicably moved, but now she felt chilled in her heart and replied numbly: "It won't work. My mother said that my sister was born rich and destined. She can't let you do rough work, otherwise your hands will become thick."
Liu Caifeng has pampered Zhao Xue since she was a child. Zhao Xiaoya has been taught to protect her sister and be her slave since she was young. She cannot let her sister work, because in the future, the good life of the family will depend on her sister.
"Don't be nervous. Mom is not here, so just relax." Zhao Xue patted her hand comfortingly, "Go and rest for a while, don't watch here. I'm not good at cooking, and I'm afraid I'll be even more confused with you watching."
Zhao Xiaoya did not insist this time and nodded obediently, "Sister, don't be tired. If you need anything, just call me."
"I know." Zhao Xue pushed her gently, "Get out quickly."
Zhao Xiaoya walked out of the kitchen, but she did not go to the lobby. Instead, she went around outside the house and hid under the kitchen window and carefully poked her head.
Zhao Xue didn't notice her and just focused on boiling water. When the water boiled, he put the noodles into the pot.
After starting the pot, Zhao Xue put the noodles into three bowls. He looked at the door defensively, and when he saw no one was there, he took out the medicine packets from his clothes and sprinkled them into two of the bowls.
Finally, after staring and thinking for a while, he reheated the pan and fried two eggs and put them in a bowl with medicine.
Zhao Xiaoya's heart sank as she looked at it. It turned out that it was exactly as she had guessed in her previous life. She didn't understand why she was framed by her family members.
She sat on the ground in a daze.
"Xiaoya!"
Hearing Zhao Xue's voice, Zhao Xiaoya took a breath, cheered up, and walked to the backyard to pick a few cucumbers.
"Where have you been?" Zhao Xue asked when he saw her.
"I saw that cucumbers will get old if I don't pick them, so I picked a few and will make cucumbers for my father tomorrow. He likes to eat them."
Zhao Xue smiled and praised her sincerely, "Little Ya is still sensible."
Zhao Xiaoya put the cucumber aside and stared at the two bowls of noodles with eggs on the stove, "It looks so delicious."
Zhao Xue noticed her gaze and sneered in her heart, but she didn't show it on her face, "These two bowls are specially made for you and dad. While mom was not here, I took two eggs to replenish your health with dad. Don't tell mom."
Looking at her smile, Zhao Xiaoya felt chills in her heart. Even if she was reincarnated, she still couldn't figure out why Zhao Xue could be so vicious at such a young age.
She was so moved when she saw this bowl of noodles with eggs in her previous life, but now she feels so disgusted.
She lowered her eyes and said, "My sister is still the best to me."
"Silly girl, you are my sister." Zhao Xue held her hand, "If I am not good to you, who will be good to you?"
Zhao Xiaoya smiled, calmly withdrew his hand, took out the wooden tray made by Zhao and placed three bowls of noodles on the tray.
Zhao Xue thought that nothing could go wrong now, and she didn't compete with Zhao Xiaoya for work.
Zhao Xiaoya glanced at the stove and said, "While there is still fire in the stove, I will boil some water first so that my sister can scrub it at night and sleep better."
Zhao Xue felt that she smelled of oily smoke and really wanted to wash herself off, "Xiaoya is so sensible and so kind to my sister."
"I have always treated my sister sincerely." Zhao Xiaoya, who was about to walk away, suddenly stopped and looked intently into Zhao Xue's eyes, "We are family."
Zhao Xiaoya was thin and small, her face was no bigger than a hand, and her eyes were even more distinct in black and white. Zhao Xue looked at her big round eyes and felt an inexplicable guilt, but in the end it just passed by.
She had been taught since she was a child that she would go to the bustling capital in the future and not stay in a mountain village for the rest of her life. Now that the time had come, betraying Zhao Xiaoya, whom she had looked down on since she was sensible, would only be painful for a moment.
"Be careful with your noodles." She used her hand as a fan, "I'm going outside first."
"Okay." Zhao Xiaoya's response was as light as a sigh.
